scope: One qualified first-paint run of the Octane demo in the official Lynx 3.9.0 macOS Explorer. This is not Android, iOS, interaction, identity, lifecycle-update, list, Native Module, or performance evidence.

explorer.signatureQualification: The release archive matched the committed SHA-256 digest. codesign --verify --deep --strict reported a sealed-resource mismatch in the upstream app archive, so the checksum-pinned app executable was launched directly.

repositoryCommand.behavior: Select the architecture-specific asset, verify and cache its archive, create an isolated per-run extraction, start the Rspeedy demo on a strict port, validate main.lynx.bundle, launch Explorer with --url, and forward shutdown to both process groups before removing the extraction.

logMarkers: App Bundle's engine version: 3.9, lynx sdk version:3.9
absentOctaneFailures: Octane Lynx roots are available only in the Lynx background runtime

gates.reasonNativeTapNotRun: Synthetic pointer input required macOS accessibility permission, which was not granted for this evidence capture.
